data.title: Supervisor Phlebotomy
data.description:
Summary

This position has direct responsibility for the quantity, quality and timeliness of all departmental work. Monitors phlebotomy team in the inpatient and outpatient department areas. Monitors quality assurance and training of new employees and communicates new policies and procedures. Maintains responsibility for quality customer relations.
Responsibilities

(40%)* Coaches, counsels, trains and develops phlebotomy team. Conducts team meetings, ensures effective utilization of laboratory computer system and ensures safe laboratory practices. Monitors productivity, competency of work, and technical accuracy of team.

data.title: Diagnostic Technician IV-Vasc
data.description:
Summary

This position performs vascular ultrasound on all inpatients and outpatients including other cardiovascular procedures.
Responsibilities

(60%)* Performs Vascular Sonographer core procedures. Performs vascular sonographer core ultrasound exams including:  extracranial ultrasound, peripheral arterial duplex, segmental pressures, renal artery Doppler, mesenteric Doppler, Transcranial Doppler, peripheral venous, venous reflux studies, vein mapping, fistula evaluations, arterial bypass evaluations and assists vascular surgeon with procedures.
